WITNESSETH: WHEREAS, Transferor is the owner of certain land in the City of New York, generally known as 308-310 East 53rd Street, New York, New York and more particularly described in Schedule B annexed hereto and made a part hereof (the "Transferor's Land"), together with the buildings and improvements located thereon (the "Transferor's Building"; the Transferor's Land and Transferor's Building being collectively referred to herein as the"Transferor's Premises"); and WHEREAS, Transferee is the owner of certain land contiguous for a minimum of ten (10) linear feet with the Transferor's Land within a single block (as defined in the Zoning Resolution of the City of New York) generally known as 1000- 1002 Second Avenue (a/k/a 300-304 East 53rd Street), New York, New York and more particularly described in Schedule A annexed hereto and made a part hereof (the "Transferee's Land"); and WHEREAS, Transferee proposes to construct improvements upon the Transferee's Land, the "Transferee's Building"; the Transferee's Land and Transferee's Building being collectively referred to herein as the"Transferee'sPremises"); and WHEREAS, the Transferee's Building will contain more floor area ("Floor Area"), as that term is defined in the ZoningResolution of the City of New York (the "Zoning Resolution"), than is now available for use under the "floor area ratio" limitation contained in the present Zoning Resolution related to the Transferee's Land as a "zoning lot,"with the result that Transferee desires to make use of the procedure available under the Zoning Resolution for combining the Transferee's Land and the Transferor's Land into a single "zoning lot" for the purpose of determining compliance by the Transferee's Building with all applicable zoning limitations; and WHEREAS, such procedure would make available to Transferee for such purpose all of the currently unused Floor Area available to the Transferor's Land under the present Zoning Resolution in excess of the Floor Area utilized by the present improvements on the Transferor's Land (the Floor Area so utilized by the present C:IWINDOwS\Temporary Intermet Files\OLKA133Zoning Lot Development Agreerment1.DOC

LLC, have heretofore executed and delivered a Declaration of Zoning Lot Restrictions creating a single zoning lot (herein called the "Combined Zoning Lot") out of the Transferee's Land and the Transferor's Land (said Declaration of Zoning Lot Restrictions,as same may hereafter be modified, amended or replaced, being referred to herein as the "Declaration").] NOW, THEREFORE, in consideration of the foregoing, Transferor and Transferee hereby agree as follows: 1. Transferor hereby grants to Transferee a perpetual easement for light and air,and unobstructedview,over a plane at an elevation described in Schedule C annexed hereto.Transferor further covenants and agrees that nobuilding or other improvement shall be constructed or allowedto exist on the Transferor'sLand and/or the Transferor's Building at a height greater than the roof of the Transferor's Building as it now exists,except for presently existing mechanical installations,bulkheads,chimneys andsimilar installations and equipment on theroof of Transferor'sBuilding(each such element being herein called a"Roof Element")and replacements of Roof Elements which do not exceed the height of the existing Roof Element replaced thereby; provided, however, if the replacement of a Roof Element is necessary from time to time to maintain the functional utility of Transferor's Building or to improve the efficiency of the operation of the Roof Element being replaced, such replacement Roof Element may exceed the on the date hereof by up to, but not in excess of, twenty (20%) percent of the height of such original replaced Roof Element existing on Transferor's Building on the date hereof, suchheight tobe measured from thebase of suchexisting original RoofElement(but not lower than the roof) to the top of such existing original Roof Element. Transferor further covenants and agrees that no new building or structure hereafter erected on the Transferor's Land, and any replacement thereof, and no alteration, reconstruction or rebuilding of the Transferor's Building, shall contain more bulk or Floor Area or utilize more zoning or development rights than the buildings or structures located on the Transferor's Land on the date hereof.
